_: Name, description and badge live in src/resources/connectors.json so the console and the browser process cannot disagree about them.

notes: The payments scope (com.intuit.quickbooks.payment) is deliberately not requested. It would let a task move money.
realmId comes back on the OAuth callback and is required in every API URL afterwards. It must be stored at grant time - there is no way to recover it from the token later.
Access tokens last an hour; refresh tokens last 100 days and are rotated on every use. Persisting the new refresh token on each exchange is not optional - miss one and the connection is dead.
Sandbox uses https://sandbox-quickbooks.api.intuit.com as the API host.

query.notes: The general read path, taking a SQL-like query string.

rate_limits.note: Per realm, plus a concurrency cap of around 10. Reports are expensive; cache rather than re-running per row.
